Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 OBJECTIVES 2 OVERVIEW 3 PLAYER TURN 4 1 : MOVE ONE OF YOURS CAMELS 5 2 : COLLECT RESOURCES 6 3 : MOVE A GUILD CAMEL 7 4 : AVAILABLE ABILITIES 8 5 : END TURN (Automatic) 9 GAME END 10 TOKEN REFERENCE 11 CLAN LEADER ABILITIES OBJECTIVES Gain influence points to become the only one master of the merchant guild. OVERVIEW Move camels around to gain resources. 3 types of resources: - Artifact : to activate effects of recruit cards or stocks of artifacts. - Recruits pawns : allow you to collect cards to link (respecting color matches) with your clan sheet and other connected recruit cards. - Yellow and blue caravan : Rally the caravans, but be careful, the small yellow caravans give small bonuses, and the blue escorted caravans are protected, they can bring big gains as big losses. SPY ON THEM FIRST! PLAYER TURN A player turn is divided into 5 phases 1: Move one of your camels 2: Collect resources 3: Move a guild camel 4: (optional) Activate "available abilities" between the start of the player's turn and before phase 5 5: End of turn 1 : MOVE ONE OF YOURS CAMELS First, if a camel of yours is outside the game area, replace it on either the central Guild tile or an Oasis tile of your choice Choose a direction, and move one of your camels in that orthogonal direction with the following conditions: - It must stop at the next available resource tile - It cannot move through opponent camels - It can move through opponent camels if they are on Guild or Oasis tiles If none of your camels can move, choose one of it and deplace it on your dashboard then skip the phase 2 "Collect Resources" 2 : COLLECT RESOURCES When you arrive on the Resource Tile, you must take one available resource between: Artifacts, Recruits, or Caravans ARTIFACT => If you pick an ARTIFACT, choose one of this two options: 1- place it in your storage and, if stacked enough, you can unlock the related ability 2- place it on an empty Artifact space on your recruit cards, and trigger all the effects adjacent to that space. Be careful, If you do not have space for an Artifact, discard the one you just gained. Be careful, the quantity of artifact cubes is limited RECRUITS PAWNS => If you pick a RECRUIT, place it on the Recruit Track and take one of the available Recruit Cards. These cards should be connected by respecting color matches. they possibly can be mis-matched, but placing cards of the same colour next to each other will allow you to use their abilities when later placing an Artifact. The new card can either be placed on the far left or far right, your clan dashboard starts with some colour openings to help you choose. If you already had artifacts in your storage, you can move immediatly them into the new spaces now created, if you want. CARAVANS => If you choose a CARAVAN, use its ability immediately or keep it camel side up to use later. —description from the publisher (English)
In SAHWARI, you are a clan leader, and you want to become the next Merchant Guildmaster. 
Develop your clan and spread your influence by venturing into the desert: gather artifacts, rally caravans or recruit the best elements for your crew... and gain SAHWARI’s people’s eternal gratitude.

SAHWARI plays in a series of turns. On each turn, the active player :
- Moves their camel on a grid. A camel is blocked by other camels!
- Collects a resource from their space. You can collect Recruits to increase your tableau, Artifacts to trigger abilities from your tableau, or rally Caravans to obtain special abilities!
- Moves a neutral Guild camel. Guild camels can be used as obstacles, and can trigger attacks in the player’s stead.
The game end triggers when there are only 6 tiles with resources on them. Count Influence gained with your Clan ability, activated abilities from your tableau, and your Recruit and Artifact storage! The player with the most influence wins.

—description from the publisher (French)
Dans SAHWARI, vous êtes un chef de clan et vous souhaitez devenir le prochain maître de la guilde marchande. Développez votre clan et étendez votre influence en vous aventurant dans le désert : rassemblez des artefacts, ralliez des caravanes ou recrutez les meilleurs éléments pour votre équipe... et gagnez la gratitude éternelle du peuple de SAHWARI.

SAHWARI se joue en une série de tours. A chaque tour, le joueur actif :
- Déplace son chameau sur une grille. Mais attention, un chameau est bloqué par d'autres chameaux !
- Collecte une ressource de leur espace : Vous pouvez collecter des recrues pour améliorer votre clan, des artefacts pour déclencher des capacités à partir de  votre fiche de clan ou rallier des caravanes pour obtenir des capacités spéciales !
- Déplace un chameau de guilde neutre. Les chameaux de guilde peuvent être utilisés comme obstacles et peuvent déclencher des attaques à la place du joueur.
La fin de partie se déclenche lorsqu'il n'y a plus que 6 tuiles contenant des ressources. Comptez l'influence gagnée avec votre capacité de clan, les capacités activées de votre tableau et votre stockage de recrutement et d'artefact ! Le joueur avec le plus d'influence gagne.

[Rating: 5/10] Ironically I just played another game that gives out points like candy for everything I do, Sahwari is the polar opposite where points are hard to come by, even most of the clan abilities don’t award much.  Furthermore, I kind of hate how movement worked and explained.  With four people the game felt very unsatisfying because there are not enough resources to go around, but in two player the guild camel becomes trivial, it often devolves into the same one being moved back and forth.  There are a couple of interesting things, but honestly not enough to overlook how unpolished and underdeveloped

[Rating: 6/10] Somewhat interesting design. I thought the way the recruits work is pretty interesting and is a cool way to build up some combo turns without making some crazy engine that breaks the game or anything. Unfortunately, the way the board works out, it seems like it is really difficult to really interact with other players. Even on a crowded board at a full player count, I never really saw anyone getting blocked from what they wanted.
